design.panel_probe: Load factory99 independently in original780 and680 programs; select dispatcher6 and execute ten increment/decrement operations to verify direct3bit feedback and clamp; select7 and decrementTL127 to98 then raw22 with77 display. No acoustic rate claim.

selection.window_rule: Exactly existing central interiors, no retiming, all eight retained
selection.f0: Prior phase_frequency_hz, fixed; no new tuning fit

estimator.basis: Joint weighted LS: DC, linear trend, sin/cos at fixed h*f0, h1..12; Hann weights. Absolute complex phase ignored, magnitude vector H1..8 divided by its L2 norm. Compare20log10 with floor−80dB after normalization. No output gain, EQ, phase, or frequency fit.
estimator.subwindows: three equal contiguous sample partitions; identical estimator
estimator.stationarity_evaluated_harmonics: H1..8 that exceed−40dB relative normalized magnitude in full window; excluded weak terms retained in full score

model.equation: u[n]=sin(theta[n]+kappa*(u[n−1]+u[n−2])/2); y[n]=sin(theta[n]+beta*u[n]); theta increments2pi*f0/48000. All beta/kappa globally shared. Equal mod/carrier phases and sine tables assumed. Output gain canceled algebraically.

free_family.optimizer: Five best deterministic grid starts; scipy least_squares with max_nfev100, finite derivative step0.001, ftol/xtol/gtol1e−8; all outcomes retained; select smallest calibration MSE only.
free_family.objective: Unweighted RMS of all4calibration×8 normalized harmonic dB residuals. Never use validation in selection.

controls.truth: Same declared recurrence at current, half-beta and double-beta; compare selected-window magnitudes to2second steady reference. Four phase starts0,.25,.5,.75cycles, each note. PCM16 quantized at peak0.25. All96 conditions retained.
controls.method_consistency: Full estimator vs each3subwindow; same1dB gate as real capture. Failed controls disqualify corresponding model numerical interpretation.

conclusion_gates.qualified_capture: All8notes pass frozen residual/clip/stationarity/H1 gates and all96 matched controls pass. Any failures retained; no alternative windows.
conclusion_gates.conditional_family_improvement: Only if qualified: freeglobal family reduces held-out RMS by>=50percent relative current and heldout absoluteRMS<=2dB, with every validation note improving; this never authorizes production.
conclusion_gates.identifiability: One modTL22 only constrains beta = phase_scale*10^(−TLslope*22/20) times unknown envelope/velocity. It cannot independently identify8pi,0.75dB,hidden source fields,effects or capture transfer. Kappa feedback law conditional.
conclusion_gates.profile: After selecting best calibration beta/kappa, profile beta at0.8/0.9/1/1.1/1.2 times best with kappa refit using calibration only; report curvature, not a hardware confidence interval.

panel_mapping.scope: Original program command mapping only, no hardware sound

findings.rejected_premise: Saw synth recipe is feedback7, not0; both original programs verify direct panel6 rawfeedback identity. Simple no-feedback Bessel inversion is invalid for this recipe.
findings.fixture: All8 real fixed low interiors pass declared clip, H1, harmonic residual and stationarity gates.
findings.controls: 92/96 meet explicitly named control accuracy/consistency criteria; four double-beta magnitude errors fail. The script also applied the shared10% residual criterion to controls, yielding84/96 after eight additional current-control residual failures. This extra scope is disclosed; original design/script/results unchanged. Overall qualification fails under either reading.
findings.model: Current conditional primitive fits stationary harmonic magnitudes much better than half/double beta or wronglydisabledfeedback. The global2parameter alternative does not pass the predeclared heldout improvement rule, even without the failed controls.
findings.identifiability: At one modTL22, beta and kappa are effective parameters conditional on recurrence, exact recipe, hidden fields and unprocessed capture. beta cannot separate8pi from0.75dB/TL, operator waveform normalization, envelope amplitude or unknown source level. No DAC bits, clock imperfection or actual internal feedback placement recovered.

failure_history.result: System Python lacked py65; no numerical result produced. Retried unchanged script with existing research venv, 44feedback steps and2TL witnesses pass. No package installed.
